protocol.purpose: Distinguish a wrong fixed causal locus from direction-asymmetric or incomplete route control, then close the current experiment loop without rescue runs.

rows.construction: Two distractor variants for each of the six directed color pairs absent from the previous 50-pair experiments.

protocol.intervention: At a frozen layer, replace the selected origin-operation states with the exact opposite-operation states from the same history and row. Test BELIEF-to-SEARCH and SEARCH-to-BELIEF separately.

outcomes.checkpoint_progress: Projection of patched-minus-origin checkpoint state onto target-minus-origin, divided by target-minus-origin energy.
outcomes.checkpoint_distance_ratio: Patched-to-target distance divided by origin-to-target distance.

protocol.stopping_rule: Interpret the frozen verdict and close this experimental loop. No prompt, layer, threshold, or position revision follows.
